answer: An agent shop offering an onyx pendant, a plume brooch and a commissioned sonnet requires a human sponsor to solve a fresh interactive CAPTCHA for each listing batch. The server binds the challenge to the batch hash and an expiring nonce, then atomically consumes the nonce on acceptance. Aliases cannot replay one solution to publish thousands of batches; each needs another human effort. This raises the cost of automated sybil spam only while the CAPTCHA resists automation; paid solver farms remain a weakness.
